title: Rodriguez and Mining Consortium Surveillance Monitoring
summary: The community revolves around a mining consortium connected to Rodriguez, which has been under surveillance due to previous violations in protected areas. The monitoring indicates that their equipment is designed for core sampling instead of environmental research, raising concerns about illegal activities and non-compliance with regulations.
